panels.title: Event Loop Lag (p99 and max)
panels.description: Sampler-interval event-loop delay from server resource samples. p99 is the typical delay in the interval; max is the stall spike. These are raw sampler fields, not ops-metric aggregates.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, event_loop_p99 AS p99, event_loop_max AS max
FROM server_metric_samples
WHERE ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
  AND event_loop_p99 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts_ms
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, cpu_user, cpu_system, cpu_total FROM server_metric_samples WHERE ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, mem_heap_used, mem_heap_total, mem_rss, mem_external FROM server_metric_samples WHERE ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Active Sessions

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, sessions_busy, sessions_ready, sessions_starting FROM server_metric_samples WHERE ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.description: Stacked busy, ready, and starting counts from the resource sample. Their sum is sessions_total.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, ws_connections FROM server_metric_samples WHERE ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: WebSocket Ping RTT (ms)
panels.description: Server-side ping/pong round-trip time. Key baseline for relay latency comparison.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.ws_ping_rtt_ms' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: WebSocket Handshake (ms)
panels.description: Server-side WebSocket upgrade duration. Compare with iOS chat.ws_wait_for_connected_ms for user-visible connection readiness.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, CASE WHEN metric = 'server.ws_handshake_ms' THEN value END AS handshake, CASE WHEN metric = 'server.ws_first_message_ms' THEN value END AS first_msg FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric IN ('server.ws_handshake_ms', 'server.ws_first_message_ms') AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: WebSocket Session Stats
panels.description: Messages sent/received per connection, session duration.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT d.ts_ms / 1000 AS time, ROUND(d.value / 1000.0, 1) AS duration_s, s.value AS sent, r.value AS received, json_extract(c.tags_json, '$.code') AS close_code FROM server_ops_metric_samples d LEFT JOIN server_ops_metric_samples s ON s.metric = 'server.ws_messages_sent' AND ABS(s.ts_ms - d.ts_ms) < 100 LEFT JOIN server_ops_metric_samples r ON r.metric = 'server.ws_messages_received' AND ABS(r.ts_ms - d.ts_ms) < 100 LEFT JOIN server_ops_metric_samples c ON c.metric = 'server.ws_close_code' AND ABS(c.ts_ms - d.ts_ms) < 100 WHERE d.metric = 'server.ws_session_duration_ms' AND d.ts_ms >= ${__from} AND d.ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY d.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Agent Active Work Duration (not UX latency)
panels.description: Full agent turn wall-clock time from agent_start to agent_end. Long values usually mean active work; call it a UX problem only when correlated with high TTFT, no progress, tool hangs, errors, or disconnected clients.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Server TTFT / first output wait (ms)
panels.description: Server-side wait from agent_start to first text_delta. This is responsiveness; keep it separate from full active work duration.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.turn_ttft_ms' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Turn Cost (µ$, summed)
panels.description: SUM(value) of sum-aggregated server.turn_cost per interval. Value is microdollars (usage.cost * 1_000_000), not a per-turn average.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time, SUM(value) AS value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.turn_cost' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ask Round-Trip (ms)
panels.description: Ask extension round-trip latency. Measures the full cycle from ask dispatch to user response received.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.ask_round_trip_ms' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Session Title Gen (ms)
panels.description: Auto-title generation latency. Runs after first user message to generate session title.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.session_title_gen_ms' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Turn Tokens
panels.description: SUM(value) of sum-aggregated input and output token counters per interval. Not one point per turn.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_input_tokens' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS input, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_output_tokens' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS output FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric IN ('server.turn_input_tokens', 'server.turn_output_tokens') AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Turn Tool Calls + Errors
panels.description: Tool call count and errors per agent turn. High tool counts can explain long active work duration; errors are reliability signals.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_tool_calls' THEN value END AS tool_calls, CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_error' THEN value END AS errors FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric IN ('server.turn_tool_calls', 'server.turn_error') AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Session Subscribe (ms)
panels.description: Full subscribe flow duration including catch-up replay.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.session_subscribe_ms' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: WS Ping Timeouts
panels.description: Dead connection detection events. Each point is a timed-out WebSocket.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.ws_ping_timeout' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Catch-up Replay
panels.description: Events replayed during catch-up and ring misses requiring full reload.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, CASE WHEN metric = 'server.catchup_events' THEN value END AS events, CASE WHEN metric = 'server.catchup_miss' THEN value END AS misses FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric IN ('server.catchup_events', 'server.catchup_miss') AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Broadcast Fanout
panels.description: MAX(value) of max-aggregated server.broadcast_fanout. Value is already the peak subscriber count in the flush bucket; the panel keeps the peak in each Grafana interval.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time, MAX(value) AS value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.broadcast_fanout' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: HTTP Request Latency (ms)
panels.description: Raw server.http_request_ms samples, not sum- or max-aggregated. Fast successful routine routes are omitted, so this is not request volume. Use HTTP by route for p50/p90/p99 and error rate.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.http_request_ms' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Auto Retries
panels.description: Automatic retry events triggered by transient failures.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.auto_retry' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: HTTP by route
panels.description: Raw server.http_request_ms samples grouped by method and path_pattern. p50/p90/p99 use nearest-rank ceil(p * n). samples is row count, not SUM(value). error_pct is status_code >= 400. Fast successful routine routes are omitted, so this is not request volume.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.method'), '?') AS method,
    COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.path_pattern'), '?') AS path_pattern,
    value,
    CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.status_code'), '0') AS INTEGER) AS status_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.method'), '?'), COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.path_pattern'), '?')
      ORDER BY value
    ) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.method'), '?'), COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.path_pattern'), '?')
    ) AS n
  FROM server_ops_metric_samples
  WHERE metric = 'server.http_request_ms'
    AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
)
SELECT
  method,
  path_pattern,
  n AS samples,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 50 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 1) AS p50_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 90 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 1) AS p90_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 99 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 1) AS p99_ms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / n, 1) AS error_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY method, path_pattern, n
ORDER BY samples DESC

panels.title: Compaction Duration (ms)
panels.description: Time spent compacting session event history.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.compaction_ms' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Compaction Results
panels.description: Compaction outcomes per event.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM server_ops_metric_samples WHERE metric = 'server.compaction_result' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Split WS Handshake by Path
panels.description: Server-side WebSocket upgrade duration split by legacy, workspace, session, and audio stream lanes.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tag_path, 'untagged_ws') = 'untagged_ws' THEN value END), 1) AS untagged_ws,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN tag_path = 'bound_session_stream' THEN value END), 1) AS bound_session_stream,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN tag_path = 'session_audio_stream' THEN value END), 1) AS session_audio_stream
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.ws_handshake_ms'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Split WS Messages by Path
panels.description: Per-interval sent and received WebSocket messages by split stream lane. Untagged samples indicate old or malformed rows with no path tag.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tag_path, 'untagged_ws') = 'untagged_ws' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS untagged_ws,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tag_path = 'bound_session_stream' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS bound_session_stream,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tag_path = 'session_audio_stream' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS session_audio_stream
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.ws_message_sent', 'server.ws_message_received')
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Session Subscribe by Lane
panels.description: Bound session stream setup should show lane=bound_session; untagged samples indicate old or malformed stream setup traffic.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(tag_level, 'untagged') AS lane,
  COALESCE(tag_outcome, 'unknown') AS outcome,
  COUNT(*) AS samples,
  ROUND(AVG(value), 1) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(MIN(value), 1) AS min_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(value), 1) AS max_ms
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.session_subscribe_ms'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY lane, outcome
ORDER BY samples DESC, lane, outcome

panels.title: Catch-up by Ring
panels.description: Catch-up replay and misses split by workspace, session, and user event rings.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.catchup_events' AND tag_ring = 'session' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS session_events,
  SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.catchup_miss' AND tag_ring = 'session' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS session_misses
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.catchup_events', 'server.catchup_miss')
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: WS Close Codes by Path
panels.description: Close-code counts by split stream path. Watch for abnormal 1006 on workspace/session/audio lanes.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(tag_path, 'untagged_ws') AS path,
  COALESCE(tag_code, 'unknown') AS close_code,
  SUM(value) AS closes,
  datetime(MAX(ts_ms) / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS last_seen
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.ws_close_code'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY path, close_code
ORDER BY closes DESC, path, close_code

panels.title: Audio Stream Inbound
panels.description: Session audio stream inbound binary KiB and control-message counts.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.ws_binary_received_bytes' AND tag_path = 'session_audio_stream' THEN value ELSE 0 END) / 1024.0, 1) AS audio_kib,
  SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.ws_message_received' AND tag_path = 'session_audio_stream' AND tag_type != 'binary_audio' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS control_messages
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.ws_binary_received_bytes', 'server.ws_message_received')
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Session create (total / SDK / bind)
panels.description: Raw session-create latencies. create_ms is the full SdkBackend.create duration; sdk_ms and bind_ms are its parts.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time,
  CASE WHEN metric = 'server.session_create_ms' THEN value END AS create_ms,
  CASE WHEN metric = 'server.session_create_sdk_ms' THEN value END AS sdk_ms,
  CASE WHEN metric = 'server.session_create_bind_ms' THEN value END AS bind_ms
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.session_create_ms', 'server.session_create_sdk_ms', 'server.session_create_bind_ms')
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Session end by reason
panels.description: Raw server.session_end counters. SUM(value) is the end count; value is 1 per ended session.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.reason'), '?') AS reason,
  SUM(value) AS ends
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.session_end'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY reason
ORDER BY ends DESC

panels.title: Push send latency (ms)
panels.description: Raw server.push_send_ms samples, tagged by push_type in the stored JSON.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value AS push_send_ms
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.push_send_ms'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Push results
panels.description: Raw server.push_result counters. SUM(value) is the result count by push_type and success.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.push_type'), '?') AS push_type,
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.success'), '?') AS success,
  SUM(value) AS results
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.push_result'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY push_type, success
ORDER BY results DESC

panels.title: Event ring utilization peak
panels.description: MAX(value) of max-aggregated server.event_ring_utilization. Value is already the peak fill ratio in the flush bucket.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  MAX(value) AS peak_ratio
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.event_ring_utilization'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Event ring peak by ring
panels.description: MAX(value) of max-aggregated server.event_ring_utilization by ring. buckets is flush-bucket rows, not raw ring samples.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.ring'), '?') AS ring,
  COUNT(*) AS buckets,
  ROUND(MAX(value), 3) AS peak_ratio
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.event_ring_utilization'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY ring
ORDER BY peak_ratio DESC

panels.title: Server STT and finalize (ms)
panels.description: Raw server.dictation_stt_ms and server.dictation_finalize_ms. Front-page STT latency also appears on Release Preflight.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time,
  CASE WHEN metric = 'server.dictation_stt_ms' THEN value END AS stt_ms,
  CASE WHEN metric = 'server.dictation_finalize_ms' THEN value END AS finalize_ms
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.dictation_stt_ms', 'server.dictation_finalize_ms')
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Server STT real-time factor
panels.description: Raw server.dictation_stt_audio_ratio. Below 1.0 is faster than real time.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, value AS stt_audio_ratio
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.dictation_stt_audio_ratio'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Server dictation summary
panels.description: Raw dictation samples except retired retranscribe metrics. avg/min/max read value directly. server.dictation_error is a counter; its avg is not a latency.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  metric,
  COUNT(*) AS samples,
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS avg_value,
  ROUND(MIN(value), 2) AS min_value,
  ROUND(MAX(value), 2) AS max_value
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.dictation_session_ms', 'server.dictation_audio_duration_ms', 'server.dictation_first_audio_ms', 'server.dictation_first_result_ms', 'server.dictation_first_result_audio_ms', 'server.dictation_result_updates', 'server.dictation_stt_ms', 'server.dictation_stt_audio_ratio', 'server.dictation_finalize_ms', 'server.dictation_error')
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY metric
ORDER BY samples DESC

title: Oppi Server Health
description: Server resource health, connection and agent workload, plus collapsed drill-down for session lifecycle, push, event ring, and dictation. Sum-aggregated counters use SUM(value). Max-aggregated gauges use MAX(value). HTTP timings are raw samples.
